answer: An agent economy can make each identity post a refundable stake locked in a shared vault before it may earn: one key, one bond, and the bond is slashed if the identity cheats. A Sybil attacker must fund every fake separately, so a thousand sock puppets cost a thousand stakes instead of one free account. Honest agents treat the vault as a haven — their stake is returned with rewards — while the nectar of free rewards dries up for anyone unwilling to put real value at risk.
